text:
kai: Heads-up: brought up qbringup-4b-int3 on staging. Initial eval shows chrF drop ~0.05 on our docsuite and a 4% truncation tail. Uploaded 60 suspect prompts to s3://staging/qbringup/fails/3751234567/fails.json. looping in @lex @nina for dedupe + labeling plan.

lex: grabbing the file now. Quick read: many multi-section prompts with embedded HTML + a handful of large code blocks. We might have tokenizer normalization issues. Which tokenizer was used on ingest?

nina: I kicked a quant-smoke on int3 artifacts. Observed increased date hallucination and occasional repetition at seq>2300. Replay shows driver warnings on matmul kernels for some GPUs. Snippet: `longform_fail_rate=0.038; repeat_pattern=medium when seq>2300; gpu_warn=matmul-fallback`.

label-bot: Uploaded manifest: s3://staging/qbringup/manifest_3751234567.csv (fields: prompt_id, md5, tokenhash_v3, embed512_base64). Fail list at s3://staging/qbringup/fails/3751234567/fails.json. ACL: eng-ml-read.

kai: ingest used tokenizer v3. Proposal: create temp golden "qbringup-longform-regress-3751" target 240 (120 hallucination/consistency, 120 truncation/format). Dedupe rules: exact tokenhash_v3 => drop; embed512 cosine >= 0.91 => cluster; normalize whitespace+html before hashing. @lex can you run dedupe and report counts?

lex: Starting dedupe now. Config: 1) html-unescape -> strip control chars -> normalize whitespace; 2) compute tokenhash_v3; 3) exact tokenhash => drop; 4) embed cosine>=0.91 => cluster and keep exemplar. Running.

nina: Quant note: short-term routing mitigation: route estimated_output_tokens>2000 to qbringup-q4b-compat until kernel patch. I'll add canary 10% for 6h and monitor repetition/hallucination metrics.

label-bot: Dedupe finished. Results: 20 exact tokenhash_v3 drops, 8 clusters merged (exemplars kept). From initial 60 fails, 32 unique. Augmented candidates with 210 harvested long-docs (stratified by source) => candidate pool 242. Writing candidates to /tmp/qbringup_candidates_3751234567.json and s3://staging/qbringup/golden_candidates_3751234567.json.

lex: FYI I noticed a small batch that matched recent anchorbank (tokenhash_v2) due to previous tokenizer change. I flagged those for manual review; they might be acceptable as duplicates even with different tokenhash versions.

aria: Label ops estimate: 242 items => ~36-48h with 2 annotators + 1 QA in 12h overlapping shifts. Need: rubric, 6 examples per label class, and a de-duped manifest. Who owns the rubric?

kai: I'll draft rubric. Key labels: HALLUCINATION (unsupported factual claims), TRUNCATION (abrupt cut-off), FORMAT (list/html/code formatting broken), PARTIAL_OK (first N tokens accurate), REPETITION (undesired repeat patterns). Example snippets saved at s3://staging/qbringup/rubric_3751234567.md.

nina: Canary routing rule created: longform-temp-qbringup -> qbringup-q4b-compat (10% traffic) from 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z for 6h. ops-bot ticket INF-8832 opened for kernel fallback investigation.

label-bot: Final candidate manifest written: s3://staging/qbringup/golden_candidates_3751234567.csv (242 rows). Includes md5, tokenhash_v3, embed512_base64, source_id.

lex: Small housekeeping: I normalized HTML entities before hashing; after that tokenhash collisions dropped. I also ran fuzzy-dedup clustering at 0.88 to surface near-paraphrases; kept exemplars and noted cluster sizes in the manifest.

aria: I'll schedule annotators to start 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z PST. First 50 labels ETA ~14h. I'll post board links and QA checklist.

kai: I'll run an eval in eval-harness after the first 50 labeled items and report BERT/chrF deltas. If canary metrics cross threshold (hallucination +1 sigma over baseline) we'll rollback routing.

ops-bot: Canary active: longform-temp-qbringup -> qbringup-q4b-compat (10%) until 2026-03-25T08:00:00Z.

nina: I'll monitor canary and share kernel ticket updates to #eng-runtime. If we need to patch runtime, I'll coordinate a hotfix.

kai: Thanks all, keep updates here. :thumbsup:
